description: This Java class 'DefaultCacheConfig' implements cache configuration logic, retrieving cache size and expiration durations from configuration and providing accessors, equality, string representation, and rendering methods.

classes.name: DefaultCacheConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing cache configuration settings such as maximumSize, expire durations, with methods to load and render configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultCacheConfig from a given Config object and path.

methods.name: getMaximumSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: getExpireAfterWrite
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire post write.

methods.name: getExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire after access.

methods.name: getExpireAfterCreate
methods.description: Returns the duration after which cache entries expire after creation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cache configuration as a Typesafe Config object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration.
